The '''Old Republic shipping fleet''',<ref name="The History of R-Series Astromech Droids">{{JournalCite|7|The History of R-Series Astromech Droids}}</ref> also known as the '''Old Republic merchant fleet'''<ref name="The Essential Guide to Droids" /> or simply the '''Republic merchant fleet''',<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was the [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide" /> It was comprised of [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruisers]] and container [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]. [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] exclusively sold their prototype [[P2-series astromech droid]]s<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids" /> to the Republic for use aboard their merchant vessels on a trial basis,<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide" /> the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] manufacturer having specifically designed them for the fleet's [[Capital ship/Legends|capital]]-scale [[Realspace/Legends|space]] [[Transport/Legends|transports]].<ref name="P2 prototype astromech droid">{{DB|droids|p2prototype|P2 prototype astromech droid}}</ref> Despite their flaws, most [[Captain/Legends|captains]] were pleased with the P2 units<ref name="The Essential Guide to Droids" /> and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] would go on to serve the shipping fleet well.<ref name="The History of R-Series Astromech Droids" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Old Republic shipping fleet was first mentioned in "[[The History of R-Series Astromech Droids]]," a [[1995]] article written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and illustrated by [[Matt Busch]] that was published in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 7|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 7]].<ref name="The History of R-Series Astromech Droids" />
